purpose: one fresh local confirmation of the frozen two-head direction/magnitude candidate on 2021-2025

causal_us_clock_contract.for_cn_session_D_with_previous_cn_sessio: use all completed US sessions after P's China close information set and before D's China open information set
causal_us_clock_contract.implementation: us_nasdaq_interval = last_US_close_strictly_before_D / last_US_close_strictly_before_P - 1; same construction for VIX; us_session_count is the number of intervening completed US sessions
causal_us_clock_contract.zero_us_sessions: interval change is 0 rather than repeating stale prior-US-day news
causal_us_clock_contract.multiple_us_sessions: use cumulative change rather than only the last US daily return

pass_gate.direction: candidate direction_hit must equal baseline direction_hit exactly because direction head is the baseline
year_robustness: candidate corr_abs_gap > 0 in every available full validation year
candidate must beat baseline on both magnitude MAE and magnitude RMSE in at least 3 of the 5 years

decision.if_pass: mark research_candidate_local_2021_2025_confirmed; keep production_authority=false pending separate production review
decision.if_fail: retain frozen baseline; record two-head candidate as not confirmed; do not retune on 2021-2025 in the same evidence cycle
